records.jp: ここは……
records.en_auxiliary: Where am I...?

records.jp: な、なに？　ここ
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what is this place?

records.jp: なんで私、こんな場所に……？
records.en_original: And how did I get here?
records.en_auxiliary: And how did I get here?
records.en: And how did I get here?

records.jp: なんなの、この場所……。<CR>夢……？　でも、夢にしては感覚がハッキリしてる……
records.en_original: Is this...a dream? No, my senses are too clear for that.
records.en_auxiliary: Is this...a dream? No, my senses are too clear for that.
records.en: What is this place...?<CR>A dream...? But everything feels too real for a dream...

records.jp: ！<CR>あれは……
records.en_auxiliary: That's...!

records.jp: なに……あれ……。生き物……なの……？
records.en_auxiliary: What...is that thing? Is it alive...?

records.jp: うわあああ！？
records.en_auxiliary: Gyaah!

records.jp: （な、なんなのアレ！　このままじゃ私……死んじゃう……？）
records.en_auxiliary: (No! Am I going to die here?)
records.en: (Wh-What is that thing!? At this rate, am I...going to die?)

records.jp: 大丈夫。あなたは戦えるよ
records.en_original: It's alright. You can fight it.
records.en_auxiliary: It's all right. You can fight it.
records.en: It's alright. You can fight it.

records.jp: 誰！？　誰かいるの？
records.en_auxiliary: Who's there?! Where are you?

records.jp: その指輪をしているあなたは、戦えるはずだよ
records.en_original: That ring should give you the power to fight it.
records.en_auxiliary: That ring should give you the power to fight it.
records.en: You should be able to fight with that ring on.

records.jp: これは？　こんなの、いつの間に
records.en_original: Huh? How did I get this?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? How did I get this?
records.en: Huh? How did I get this?

records.jp: さあ、指輪に願いを込めて
records.en_auxiliary: Now, wish upon the ring.
records.en: Now, put your wish into the ring.

records.jp: それが、あなたの力になる
records.en_original: That will give you the strength you need.
records.en_auxiliary: It will give you the strength you need.

records.jp: 願い……？
records.en_auxiliary: Wish...?

records.jp: さっき『死んでるようなものだ』って言っていたけど――
records.en_original: Just now, you said you were "as good as dead," but--
records.en_auxiliary: Just now, you said you were "as good as dead," but—
records.en: Just now, you said you were "as good as dead," but--

records.jp: まだ、死んでいないでしょう？<CR>ここで死にたくはないでしょう？
records.en_original: You're not dead yet, right? <CR>And you don't want to die HERE, do you?
records.en_auxiliary: You're not dead yet, right?<CR>And you don't want to die here, do you?
records.en: You're not dead yet, are you?<CR>You don't want to die here, do you?

records.jp: ……うん
その想いを、力にするの
records.en_original: Then turn that desire into strength.
records.en_auxiliary: Then turn that desire into strength.

records.jp: 大丈夫。その指輪をつけることができた、あなたなら……
records.en_original: It's okay. If you're able to wear the ring, you can do it...
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay. If you're able to wear that ring, you can do it...
records.en: You'll be fine. You were able to wear that ring, after all...

records.jp: さあ、急いで
records.en_auxiliary: Now, hurry.

records.jp: わかった
records.en_auxiliary: All right.
Wh-whaaat?!

records.jp: なにこれ……？　チュチュ……？
records.en_auxiliary: Am I...wearing a tutu...?

records.jp: リフレクター。あなたの力よ
records.en_original: You're a Reflector. This is your power.
records.en_auxiliary: You're a Reflector. This is your power.
records.en: You're a Reflector. This is your power.

records.jp: リフレクター……
records.en_auxiliary: A Reflector...

records.jp: その力で敵を倒して
records.en_original: Now use that power to defeat your foe.
records.en_auxiliary: Now use that power to defeat your foe.
records.en: Now use that power to defeat your foe.

records.jp: でも、私はもう、足が……
records.en_original: But, with my leg the way it is, I can't...
records.en_auxiliary: But, with my leg the way it is, I can't...
records.en: But, with my leg the way it is, I can't...

records.jp: それに、力って何？　まさか素手で戦うの？
records.en_original: And what do you mean, my power? Do you expect me to fist-fight this thing?
records.en_auxiliary: And what do you mean, my power? Do you expect me to fistfight that thing?
records.en: And what do you mean by 'power'? You don't expect me to fight that thing barehanded, do you?

records.jp: 大丈夫。この力があれば現実の怪我は関係ない
records.en_original: Don't worry. With your power, your real-life injuries don't matter.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. With your power, your real-life injuries don't matter.
records.en: Don't worry. With this power, your injuries in the real world don't matter.

records.jp: あなたのその足も、動くはずだよ
records.en_original: You should be able to move your leg now.
records.en_auxiliary: You should be able to move your leg now.
records.en: You should be able to move your leg now.

records.jp: うわあっ
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa!

records.jp: 足が……。膝が……痛くない……。<CR>動く……！　動ける！！
records.en_original: My leg... My knee... It doesn't hurt... It can move...! <CR>I can move!!
records.en_auxiliary: My leg... My knee... It doesn't hurt... It can move...!<CR>I can move!!
records.en: My leg... My knee... It doesn't hurt...<CR>It moves...! I can move!!

records.jp: それに今のジャンプ――
records.en_auxiliary: And that jump just now—

records.jp: さあ、早く武器を出して
records.en_original: Now, hurry and draw your weapon.
records.en_auxiliary: Now, hurry and draw your weapon.
records.en: Now, hurry and summon your weapon.

records.jp: 武器を、出す？
records.en_auxiliary: What weapon?

records.jp: あなたの想いが、力になると
records.en_auxiliary: When your desire becomes power...

records.jp: その指輪に――
records.en_auxiliary: That ring will—

records.jp: これは……
records.en_auxiliary: It's a...

records.jp: 右目と同じ、青色の剣――
records.en_original: A sword, as blue as your right eye.
records.en_auxiliary: A sword, as blue as your right eye.
records.en: A sword, as blue as your right eye.

records.jp: 青い目……？
records.en_auxiliary: Since when is my eye...?

records.jp: な、なにこれ？　それに、髪も……！？
records.en_original: W-What is this? And my hair...!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what is this? And my hair...!
records.en: W-What is this? And my hair...!

records.jp: くっ……！
records.en_auxiliary: Tch...!

records.jp: さあ、戦って！
records.en_auxiliary: Now, fight!

records.jp: あなたの力で！
records.en_auxiliary: With your strength!

records.jp: ～バトルについて～
records.en_auxiliary: ~About Battles~

records.jp: 戦闘はターン制のコマンドバトルです。<CR>ターンが回ってきたときにコマンドを選択します
records.en_original: Battles are fought through a turn-based command system. When your turn comes, simply select a command.
records.en_auxiliary: Battles are fought through a turn-based command system. When your turn comes, simply select a command.
records.en: Battles use a turn-based command system.<CR>When your turn comes, select a command.

records.jp: ターンが回ってくるタイミング（ウェイト、ＷＴ）は<CR>タイムライン（ＴＬ）上で確認することができます
records.en_original: You can see the wait time (WT) until your next turn by checking the timeline (TL).
records.en_auxiliary: You can see the wait time (WT) until your next turn by checking the timeline (TL).
records.en: You can see the wait time (WT) until your next turn<CR>on the Timeline (TL).

records.jp: ～バトルコマンドについて～
records.en_auxiliary: ~About Battle Commands~

records.jp: <IM10>で選び、<IM00>でコマンドを決定します
records.en_original: You can choose your command with <IM10>, and select it with <IM00>.
records.en_auxiliary: You can choose your command with <IM10>, and use <KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_OK> to confirm your selection.
records.en: Use <IM10> to choose a command, then press <IM00> to confirm.

records.jp: スキルを使用する時は、設定されているＭＰを消費します。<CR>ＭＰが足りないとスキルを発動することができません
records.en_original: Using a skill will draw from your reserve of MP. You won't be able to use a skill if you don't have enough.
records.en_auxiliary: Using a skill will draw from your reserve of MP. You won't be able to use a skill if you don't have enough.
records.en: Using a skill consumes its set amount of MP.<CR>You cannot activate a skill if you do not have enough MP.

records.jp: 一部のスキルには、相手のＷＴを延ばして<CR>行動を遅らせるノックバック効果がついています
records.en_original: Some skills have a knockback effect, which will extend the opponent's WT and delay their next move.
records.en_auxiliary: Some skills have a knockback effect, which will extend the opponent's WT and delay their next move.
records.en: Some skills have a knockback effect that extends the target's WT,<CR>delaying their action.

records.jp: 相手から攻撃を受ける回数を減らすことができますので、<CR>有効的に活用していきましょう
records.en_original: They can reduce the number of attacks you receive from your opponent, so use them to your advantage.
records.en_auxiliary: They can reduce the number of attacks you receive from your opponent, so use them to your advantage.
records.en: They can reduce the number of attacks you take,<CR>so use them to your advantage.
